pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102120

In case of multiple aggs with the same expression, the layout has multiple entries pointing to the same position.
Project planning didn't manage this situation properly, resulting in the same entry appearing multiple times in the layout and pointing to multiple positions (that violates the layout contract).
The planning of the following commands (eg. MV_EXPAND) resulted in a NullPointerException, because the layout.inverse() could not be calculated properly.
pr_title: ES|QL: Fix layout management for Project
pr_comment: Hi @luigidellaquila, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: I noticed that this map is no longer populated with newly created `new Layout.ChannelSet`. Is it intended?

Keen eyes.

Definitely not _intended_. Although, looking at the `else`-branch in line 594, I can't _say_ that the `else`-branch would actually be more correct because it may not place the projected column in the correct position in the `layout`. That would require investigation (and probably depends on how the output operator works, resp. if it relies on the layout order).
The channelSet was added anyway, even if it was already added previously, resulting in duplicate entries in the layout.
